verdict.rationale: Stable's marketing describes keyword-based auto-routing of incoming mail to teams, AI-powered automatic sorting, configurable Slack/email alerts on new mail, and automated check deposits. Webhooks also notify external systems of account events, which allows rule-driven automation built elsewhere. A general user-defined rule engine is not evidenced, and the claims are marketing-level only. Missing for 10: documented rule configuration (conditions and actions), rules that trigger arbitrary actions such as auto-forward, shred or scan, an API for managing rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
